""" from bs4 import BeautifulSoup from typing import Dict, List, Optional import re # EVOLVE-BLOCK-START def scrape_api_docs(html_content: str) -> List[Dict[str, any]]: """ Extract API documentation from HTML content. Args: html_content: Raw HTML content of a documentation page Returns: List of dictionaries containing function documentation """ soup = BeautifulSoup(html_content, "html.parser") functions = [] seen_names = set() # 1. Look for dt elements with sig class (Sphinx-style docs) dt_blocks = soup.find_all("dt", class_="sig") for block in dt_blocks: sig_name = block.find(class_="sig-name") if sig_name: name = sig_name.get_text(strip=True) if name not in seen_names: seen_names.add(name) signature = block.get_text(strip=True) # Extract return type if present return_type = "unknown" sig_return = block.find(class_="sig-return") if sig_return: return_type = sig_return.get_text(strip=True) # Find description in next dd element dd = block.find_next_sibling("dd") description = "" params_info = {} if dd: # Get main description from first paragraph first_p = dd.find("p") if first_p: description = first_p.get_text(strip=True) else: description = dd.get_text(strip=True)[:300] # Extract parameter descriptions from dl/dt/dd structure param_list = dd.find("dl", class_="field-list") if param_list: for param_dt in param_list.find_all("dt"): param_name = param_dt.get_text(strip=True) param_dd = param_dt.find_next_sibling("dd") if param_dd: params_info[param_name] = param_dd.get_text(strip=True)[:150] if not description: description = "No description found" functions.append({ "name": name, "signature": signature, "description": description, "parameters": extract_parameters(signature, params_info), "return_type": return_type, }) # 2. Look for function signatures in headers for tag in ["h3", "h2", "h4"]: headers = soup.find_all(tag) for block in headers: text = block.get_text(strip=True) if "(" in text and ")" in text: name = text.split("(")[0].strip() if name and name not in seen_names: seen_names.add(name) # Look for description - try multiple elements description = "" next_p = block.find_next_sibling("p") if next_p: description = next_p.get_text(strip=True) else: next_div = block.find_next_sibling("div") if next_div: description = next_div.get_text(strip=True)[:300] if not description: description = "No description found" functions.append({ "name": name, "signature": text, "description": description, "parameters": extract_parameters(text, {}), "return_type": "unknown", }) # 3. Look for code blocks with adjacent descriptions code_blocks = soup.find_all("code") for block in code_blocks: text = block.get_text(strip=True) if "(" in text and ")" in text and len(text) < 200: name = text.split("(")[0].strip() if name and name not in seen_names and name.replace("_", "").isalnum(): seen_names.add(name) # Try to find description in parent or next sibling parent = block.parent description = "" if parent: next_elem = parent.find_next_sibling() if next_elem and next_elem.name in ["p", "div"]: description = next_elem.get_text(strip=True) if not description: description = "No description found" functions.append({ "name": name, "signature": text, "description": description, "parameters": extract_parameters(text, {}), "return_type": "unknown", }) return functions[:35] # Return more functions for better completeness def extract_parameters(signature: str, param_descriptions: Dict[str, str] = None) -> List[Dict[str, str]]: """ Extract parameter information from a function signature.
